summary.text: Frank Bogulski is the Conservative Party and Republican candidate for the New York State Assembly, District 149, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces Adam Bojak (Democratic and Working Families Party) for a seat with no incumbent.

paragraphs.text: Frank Bogulski was the Republican, Conservative Party and Support Police Party candidate for Erie County Legislature District 9 in 2021.
He lost the November 2, 2021 general election to incumbent John Gilmour, receiving 48.8 percent of the vote to Gilmour's 51.1 percent.
